The application's FastSAM licence entry also links directly to that download.
No login, special password or licence purchase is required to copy the source.
The distributor maintains equivalent source access as required by AGPL 6(d).

The archive supplies the preferred checkpoint/configuration, full pinned
Ultralytics 8.4.107 model/export sources, the actually executed export.py,
pinned tools/portable instructions, original notices, full AGPL and recorded
source verification. Export source commit:
efacaada0f20c5dc8d4fec6d2412f742a5233d21.

The computation graph and source parameters correspond. This is not a promise
of bit-identical builds or universal numerical identity: the recorded strict
test fails on nine low-confidence bounding-box values in one synthetic input;
the difference and separate source conclusion are preserved inside the archive.
The application continues to use the unchanged original ONNX identified above.
